atoms.b: In the UK, most of our land is ((++rural flat)). Despite this, around 80% of people live in urban areas, whereas only ((++20% 1%)) of people live in rural areas.

As they provide more opportunities for education and ((++employment dancing)), urban settlements tend to have a higher population of ((++young fun)) people. Many people migrate from rural to urban areas just for this reason.

hint.text: Migration is when people move from one place to another, often in search of a better quality of life.
hint.label: Migrate

atoms.b: When ((++cities weeds)) grow and expand into rural areas, it can lead to the loss of farmland and ((++habitats hats)). This is what we call urban sprawl.
